Definition: neuter of a compound of a derivative of G906 (used for the comparative of G18); better:--very well.
BiblicalUsage: The word beltion means better, very well, and it shows up only once, in 2 Timothy 1:18.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe beltion is worth knowing, because every word God chose carries weight.
